title: Cross-mode lock exclusion through real Discord component handlers
priority: P1 — impedir que um participante aceite um convite 1v1 enquanto está travado em TagDuel, ou aceite TagDuel enquanto é dono de convite 1v1; rollback precisa preservar os dois convites e locks.

scenarios.name: TagDuel host blocks 1v1 Accept
steps: create TagDuel lobby with B as accepted host
assert pending invitation/revision/state and both lock tables unchanged
route the same current 1v1 Accept again
scenarios.expected: first Accept rejected; after lobby cancellation the same invitation can start the duel

scenarios.name: 1v1 invitation owner blocks TagDuel Accept
steps: create TagDuel lobby with C host and B pending
assert lobby/member/revision and lock tables unchanged
route the same current TagDuel Accept again
scenarios.expected: first TagDuel Accept rejected; after decline the same lobby member can accept

discordValidation: Offline integration through handleDuelComponent and handleTagComponent with mocked Discord acknowledgements/payload validation; no gateway credentials.
limitations: SQLite temporary file; no production DB.
Discord handlers are real, but interaction objects and delivery callbacks are mocked; no live guild/API call.
